item.title: Group reviewing net-zero goals to publish key report next week
item.description: A GROUP set up to provide independent scrutiny of the government’s Carbon Neutral Roadmap, which proposes a way for Jersey to emit no more carbon than it can absorb by 2050, is due to release a key report next week. item.title: Senior Tennis Inter-Insular returns to Jersey
item.description: VETERAN players from Jersey and Guernsey will renew one of the island’s long-standing sporting rivalries this weekend when the Over-55 tennis inter-insular returns at Caesarean Tennis Club. item.title: Young people sought to represent Jersey in Sydney
item.description: JERSEY is seeking two young Islanders to represent the Island at the Commonwealth Youth Parliament in Sydney from 26 to 31 July. The programme, run by the Commonwealth Parliamentary Association, brings together 18–29-year-olds from across the Commonwealth to learn about parliamentary processes. item.title: Police say they “will not tolerate any form of hate crime” as man arrested over alleged attack on Muslim men
